owner_role: Supervisor selecting the human-directed K2 follow-up
hypothesis: If integrated K2 raises complete-step rate by at least 3%, spending that speed inside the fixed 1800-second budget may improve fresh public20M BPB on audited eight-layer e1e2.
single_causal_change: Enable the independently reviewed K2 embedding backward; all architecture, optimizer, data, seed and schedule settings remain the audited-base settings.
prediction_note: Unknown; faster training can worsen repeated-data quality. Timing is not a BPB win.

control.requirement: Actual same-host kind=control, exact e1e2 base, valid fixed-budget fresh20M/context1024 for unchanged decide.py. Historical clean replay remains its original kind.

candidate.short_run_difference: Remove only --num-steps 45 from the reviewed ON timing command.
candidate.legal_shape: full chip, LNC2, four ranks, pack32, context1024, batch131072

gates.cpu_exactness_and_off_three_steps: PASS; author receipts and one independent review archived
gates.native_prerequisite: Completed valid same-host OFF/ON45 pair under 20260926-k2-final-sprint-timing; finite steps, supported exact source execution, complete 45 boundary observations, ON/OFF whole-window rate >=1.03, cold startup and charge recorded.
gates.fresh_machine_checks: Original exclusive lifetime flock, fresh ps and neuron-ls, exact source/argv, disk/RAM admission preserving both short checkpoints and protected/shared caches. No concurrent job.
gates.no_new_source_review: Same exact accepted source; different run length only. Do not add a second review or full-size CPU ceremony.

accounting.official_budget: Unmodified runner/prepare accounting: capped first-five startup exclusion, all excess charged, over_budget=false.
accounting.steps: Report only, not adoption gate; below60% of control is a sanity alarm requiring investigation.
accounting.cache_provenance: Research-only reuse of selected host's ON45 private cache namespace; hit must be observed, not assumed.
accounting.cold_startup: Retain ON45 genuinely cold measurement. Warm full quality result is not submission qualification and cannot conceal cold excess; a future candidate needs a genuinely cold full replay, fresh20M and Claude audit.

evaluation.mode: fresh-process prepare.py eval-public using the actual produced checkpoint

success_criteria.timing_to_full: Only the valid precommitted >=3% whole-step gain releases this research run.
success_criteria.quality: Unchanged workflow/tools/decide.py thresholds, comparable same-host control and required replication; no favorable seed selection.
success_criteria.submission: Separate human-only upload after confirmed >=0.003 official improvement target, genuinely cold replay/fresh20M and Claude audit. No upload permission here.

retry_policy: Save actual error, one diagnosed unique-label retry, then park. Release lock only after owned descendants end and independent device/process idle checks.
artifacts: Retain exact source, argv, environment/cache provenance, train/eval logs, startup/charge/steps/rates, checkpoint identity, results, comparison and verdict in repository ledger.
human_approved_by: Poojith, Final Sprint standing development authorization
